fusions.name: Skipping Crescent
fusions.desc: Skims a curved blade over the surface for 4 water damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds, then skips to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shake Dry
fusions.desc: Cuts a full circle that deals 26 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Shrugged Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Returned to Sender
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be hooked off you and onto whoever inflicted it. You have 8% water resistance.
